name: Assumption
overview: The topic of Assumption calls believers to exercise humility and discernment, avoiding hasty judgments and presumptions about others, as cautioned in Proverbs and Matthew. Scripture warns against answering or judging before understanding the full matter, highlighting the folly of premature conclusions. At the same time, the gospel promise in John 3:16 assures that faith in Christ brings eternal life, underscoring the importance of rightly discerning spiritual truths rather than making unfounded assumptions. This balance encourages believers to seek wisdom and love rather than prideful or impulsive judgments.
